name: images
description: Make or edit still images with Glif and save them where they belong: concept art, posters, variations, illustrations, website visuals (hero images, textures, OG images), logos and app icons with every export size, game art (character sheets, sprite sheets, seamless textures), and edits to an existing image (remove the background, erase, expand, upscale, restyle). Use when: "make an image of", "generate a picture", "make 10 variations", "poster for", "mockup of", "add a hero image", "this page needs visuals", "background texture", "OG image", "design a logo", "app icon", "favicon set", "character sheet", "sprite sheet", "seamless texture", "remove the background", "make this a transparent PNG", "expand this to 16:9", "upscale this", "restyle this as pixel art". NOT for: ads, product shots, thumbnails or store graphics (use ads-and-promo), or video and audio (use video-and-audio).
